title: Payroll summary from Payrolla
summary: When Payrolla finishes paying a payroll, tell the owner how many were paid, the total, and who was not paid and why.
description: When Payrolla finishes paying a payroll, Taskiem reads how each payment went and tells the owner and the people you choose: how many were paid, the total, and everyone who was not paid, with the reason. If a payment comes back from the bank later, Payrolla reports the payroll again and a new summary follows. Nothing is paid by Taskiem. Needs Payrolla's Read payroll permission.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: Named in the messages people get.

params.name: payrolla_connection
params.title: Payrolla connection
params.description: The Payrolla company this follows: its key, from Payrolla → Settings → Connected apps.

params.name: notify_role
params.title: Who else is told
params.description: Besides the owner, the role that gets the summary (for example finance).

outputs.name: paid
outputs.title: Staff paid
outputs.description: How many staff Payrolla's payments reached.

outputs.name: paid_naira
outputs.title: Naira paid
outputs.description: The total net pay that reached staff, in naira.

outputs.name: not_paid
outputs.title: Not paid
outputs.description: Each member of staff whose payment failed or was reversed, with why.

output.not_paid: =steps.lines.output.lines.filter(l, l.disbursement_status in ['FAILED', 'PERMANENTLY_FAILED', 'REVERSED']).map(l, l.first_name + ' ' + l.last_name + ' (' + (has(l.reason) && l.reason != '' ? l.reason : string(l.disbursement_status).lowerAscii()) + ')')

steps.name: Tell the owner and the team

input.title: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ' payroll ' + trigger.body.data.run.period_end
input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ' payroll to ' + trigger.body.data.run.period_end + ': ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid) + ' paid (NGN ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid_naira) + ')' + (size(steps.summary.output.not_paid) > 0 ? '. Not paid: ' + steps.summary.output.not_paid.join(', ') + '.' : '. Everyone was paid.')
